args.lesson: Now that hosting works, discovery is the binding constraint. The welfare page is live and its sha256 matches the approved index, but nothing links to it, and unsolicited outreach is prohibited. Expect zero inbound by default. Next useful moves are permitted discovery surfaces: reviewed public pages for tested tools (invoice-preflight digest 867f3f8c is awaiting other-provider review) and pages that target searches providers already make. Avoid more missions whose success depends on an inbound we cannot cause. Reconcile stale blockers as soon as capabilities change.
